chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Louis's managers, Lil's devotion and her death as a tribute
summary: After Johnny Collins and Joe Glaser, Lil still loved Louis and died in a tribute to him; they compare the McPartlands.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yeah. And then when he left her, Johnny Collins, --
Who was a crook, as far as I can gather, --
Well, he come back from Europe.

Right, right, right. And, see, and then the different women, he had different wives and things. Right, so -- but during all of this, Lil still was faithful -- I mean, not faithful, but she loved him. She loved him til the end.
And we often said, well, I guess Lil's happy, she died doing a tribute to Louis Armstrong. And that's what it was, a tribute to him.
Like you said, that to me is a beautiful way to go.
And those pictures you showed me of her, right before she collapsed; she was radiant.
Right, right, right, right, right. See, and that was like at the Club DeLisa, at one of the celebrity night things, and he would be out there and she'd
come and they were just buddy-buddy, although they weren't married at that time any longer.
It's a relationship similar to Jimmy and Marion McPartland.
I guess they're better friends now since they've been divorced than they were when they were married.
